name: Monex Group, Inc.
summary: Monex Group, Inc., an online financial institution, provides retail online brokerage services in Japan, the United States, and internationally. The company offers M&A advisory; forex and cryptocurrency exchange; securities investment; investor and investment education; asset and wealth management; education and child developmental support system; life settlement business; Genomic data platform business; investment fund and portfolio management, and exempt market dealership; investment advisory; private banking; custodial trust for the administration and disposition of trust assets; venture capital; and human resource development services.
